capability.title: Usable V1 Job Review
capability.outcome: The operator can review a small ranked set of real jobs, understand fit and safely record review decisions in the Control Center.
acceptance_criteria: Review Queue is usable without console archaeology.
Actions expose evidence and side effects.
validation: UI/service tests and realistic operator smoke.

stories.title: Define V1 Top-5 Job Review Contract
stories.outcome: V1 has explicit user journey, ranking semantics, inputs, exclusions and success metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Top-5 means a reproducible ranked review set.
Hard filters, freshness and uncertainty are visible.
validation: Contract review and deterministic fixture examples.

stories.title: Job Review Read Model
stories.outcome: One read model supplies job, employer, fit, freshness, evidence and review state.
acceptance_criteria: No N+1 hidden logic in templates.
validation: DB/view tests and UI view-model tests.

stories.title: Review Queue Usability Slice
stories.outcome: Operator can sort, filter and inspect the small V1 queue without CLI archaeology.
acceptance_criteria: Clear lanes, evidence badges, blockers and next actions.

stories.title: Approval-Safe Review Actions Backend
stories.outcome: Review decisions call bounded services with visible side effects and audit records.
acceptance_criteria: Each action has permission, idempotency and audit contract.
validation: Service, route, CSRF/permission and DB integration tests.

stories.title: V1 End-to-End Operator Proof
stories.outcome: A realistic job can move from read model through operator review without hidden mutation.
acceptance_criteria: Scripted evidence packet and operator checklist pass.
Failure and retry paths are demonstrated.

stories.title: Runtime Agent Health Model
stories.outcome: Agent Monitor distinguishes derived lifecycle signals from real run health.
acceptance_criteria: Run/health table or view defines heartbeat, last outcome, failure class and freshness.
